# MCP surface

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-mcp-surface.mjs — do not hand-edit. Re-run `node scripts/gen-mcp-surface.mjs` after any prompt/resource/tool change and commit the diff. -->

Live prompts → resources → tools hierarchy of all three MCP servers shipped from this repo, captured from each server's own `tools/list`, `resources/list`, `resources/templates/list`, and `prompts/list` responses (plus `completion/complete` probes for resource-template arguments) — the same client-bridge pattern as `evals/framework/mcp-call.mjs`, not hand-maintained prose.

This page is the machine-facing reference. For narrative documentation of the same surface — installation, worked examples, and transcripts — see the usage guide at [`docs/guide/`](guide/index.html).

## Legend

- **[UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL]** — title or description contains "unofficial" or "experimental": content derived/parsed by this server rather than published or endorsed by the FinOps Foundation, the FOCUS project, or the Tokenomics Foundation (`official: false` in structured output). Unmarked entries are official framework/FOCUS/Tokenomics Foundation content, restructured.

## finops-framework server

Data v2.1.1, crawled 2026-07-23. The surface a default `npx finops-framework-mcp` serves.

**4 prompt(s) · 11 fixed resource(s) + 4 template(s) (44 concrete resource(s) listed) · 11 tool(s)**

### Prompts

#### `explain-framework`

Explain the FinOps Framework

- `audience` (optional) — Who the explanation is for

#### `assess-capability-maturity`

Assess a capability's maturity

- `capability` (required) — Capability slug, e.g. 'allocation'

#### `plan-maturity-roadmap`

Plan a maturity roadmap

- `capability` (required) — Capability slug
- `current` (required) — Current level: crawl|walk|run
- `target` (required) — Target level: crawl|walk|run

#### `map-personas-to-capabilities`

Map personas to capabilities

- `persona` (optional) — Persona slug (finops-practitioner, finance, itam, …); omit for all

### Resources

#### Fixed

- `finops://framework/overview` — FinOps Framework overview (text/markdown) — Start here: what the framework contains and how to navigate this server.
- `finops://framework/principles` — The 6 FinOps Principles (text/markdown) — The 6 FinOps Principles
- `finops://framework/phases` — The 3 FinOps Phases (iterative lifecycle) (text/markdown) — The 3 FinOps Phases (iterative lifecycle)
- `finops://framework/domains` — The 4 FinOps Domains with their capabilities (text/markdown) — The 4 FinOps Domains with their capabilities
- `finops://framework/technology-categories` — The 5 Technology Categories (FinOps for Cloud/SaaS/AI/Data Center/Data Cloud) (text/markdown) — The 5 Technology Categories (FinOps for Cloud/SaaS/AI/Data Center/Data Cloud)
- `finops://framework/maturity-model` — Official Crawl/Walk/Run maturity levels (text/markdown) — Official Crawl/Walk/Run maturity levels
- `finops://framework/scopes` — FinOps Scopes — conceptual guidance document (text/markdown) — FinOps Scopes — conceptual guidance document
- `finops://framework/personas` — All 11 personas (6 core + 5 allied) (text/markdown) — All 11 personas (6 core + 5 allied)
- `finops://framework/capabilities` — All 22 capabilities grouped by domain (text/markdown) — All 22 capabilities grouped by domain
- `finops://framework/meta/manifest` — Data manifest (application/json) — Data/schema versions, crawl date, counts, source URLs, attribution.
- `finops://framework/meta/changelog` — Crawl changelog (application/json) — Rolling per-crawl diff summaries (what changed between data versions).

#### Templates

#### `finops://framework/capabilities/{slug}`

Capability document (text/markdown) — Full capability document: definition, maturity assessments, activities, KPIs, inputs/outputs.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. allocation, anomaly-management, architecting-workload-placement, automation-tools-services, budgeting, …)

#### `finops://framework/personas/{slug}`

Persona document (text/markdown) — One persona's goals, objectives, and capability involvement.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. engineering, finance, finops-practitioner, itam, itfm, …)

#### `finops://framework/capabilities/{slug}/maturity/{level}`

Capability maturity level (text/markdown) — One capability's official assessment text at one level (crawl|walk|run).

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. allocation, anomaly-management, architecting-workload-placement, automation-tools-services, budgeting, …); `level`: completable (e.g. crawl, walk, run)

#### `finops://framework/kpis/{slug}`

KPI library entry (text/markdown) — Full KPI record: description, formula, data sources, related capabilities.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. active-to-provisioned-user-ratio, allocation-accuracy-index-aai, anomaly-detected-carbon-avoidance, anomaly-detected-cost-avoidance, anomaly-detection-rate, …)

### Tools

#### `get_framework_info`

Framework & server orientation

_(no parameters)_

#### `search_framework`

Search the framework

- `query`, required, string, length 2–∞ — Keywords, e.g. 'unallocated spend tagging'
- `entity_types`, optional, array<enum(capability|kpi|persona|principle|phase|domain|technology-category|maturity-level|scope)> — Restrict to these entity types (default: all)
- `limit`, optional, integer, default `10`, range 1–50
- `cursor`, optional, string — Opaque cursor from a previous call

#### `list_capabilities`

List capabilities

- `domain`, optional, string — Domain slug, e.g. 'understand-usage-and-cost'
- `persona`, optional, string — Persona slug, e.g. 'finance'
- `limit`, optional, integer, default `50`, range 1–50
- `cursor`, optional, string

#### `get_capability`

Get one capability

- `capability`, required, string — Capability slug, e.g. 'allocation'
- `include`, optional, array<enum(summary|definition|maturity|activities|kpis|headline_groups|inputs_outputs)> — Sections to return (default [summary, definition])
- `persona`, optional, string — With include:['activities']: return only this persona's activities

#### `get_maturity_assessment`

Get official maturity assessment

- `capability`, required, string — Capability slug, e.g. 'allocation'
- `level`, optional, enum(crawl|walk|run) — One level; omit for all three official levels

#### `get_kpis`

Get KPIs (full records)

- `slug`, optional, string — Exact KPI slug for a single-record lookup, e.g. 'allocation-accuracy-index-aai'
- `capability`, optional, string — Only KPIs featured on or officially related to this capability
- `featured_only`, optional, boolean, default `false` — With `capability`: only KPIs featured on that capability's own page; alone: only KPIs featured on some page
- `limit`, optional, integer, default `25`, range 1–100
- `cursor`, optional, string

#### `assess_maturity_path`

Maturity gap between two levels

- `capability`, required, string — Capability slug, e.g. 'allocation'
- `current_level`, required, enum(crawl|walk|run) — Starting maturity level, exclusive — the gap begins above this
- `target_level`, required, enum(crawl|walk|run) — Ending maturity level, inclusive — must be above current_level

#### `map_personas`

Persona ↔ capability mapping

- `capability`, optional, string — Capability slug, e.g. 'allocation'
- `persona`, optional, string — Persona slug, e.g. 'finance'

#### `get_entity`

Get full text of a small framework entity

- `entity_type`, required, enum(principles|phases|domains|technology-categories|scopes|persona)
- `slug`, optional, string — Required for entity_type 'persona'; ignored otherwise

#### `get_maturity_model`

Get the maturity model

_(no parameters)_

#### `get_changelog`

Data changelog

- `limit`, optional, integer, default `5`, range 1–20

## finops-focus server

FOCUS spec versions 1.0, 1.2; latest 1.2.

**3 prompt(s) · 3 fixed resource(s) + 4 template(s) (125 concrete resource(s) listed) · 9 tool(s)**

### Prompts

#### `explain-focus`

Explain the FOCUS spec

- `version` (optional) — Which version to focus on (1.0|1.2); default latest

#### `map-column-across-versions`

Trace one column across FOCUS versions

- `column` (required) — Column ID, e.g. 'BilledCost'

#### `map-kpi-to-focus-columns` **[UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL]**

Map a framework KPI to FOCUS columns

- `kpi` (optional) — Framework KPI slug, e.g. 'effective-savings-rate-percentage'
- `capability` (optional) — Framework capability slug, e.g. 'rate-optimization'
- `version` (optional) — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"

### Resources

#### Fixed

- `focus://spec/overview` — FOCUS spec server overview (text/markdown) — Start here: what this server covers and how to navigate its version-pinned tools.
- `focus://spec/versions` — FOCUS spec versions (application/json) — Every FOCUS spec version served, with source tag and counts.
- `focus://spec/changes/1.0-1.2` — FOCUS 1.0→1.2 diff **[UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL]** (text/markdown) — Unofficial column diff between the two pinned spec versions, source-cited.

#### Templates

#### `focus://spec/{version}/columns/{slug}`

FOCUS column document (text/markdown) — Full column record: description, content constraints, allowed values, normative requirements.

Completion: `version`: completable (e.g. 1.0, 1.2); `slug`: completable (e.g. availabilityzone, billedcost, billingaccountid, billingaccountname, billingaccounttype, …)

#### `focus://spec/{version}/attributes/{slug}`

FOCUS attribute document (text/markdown) — Full attribute record: description, normative requirements, exceptions.

Completion: `version`: completable (e.g. 1.0, 1.2); `slug`: completable (e.g. column_handling, currency_format, datetime_format, discount_handling, key_value_format, …)

#### `focus://spec/{version}/glossary`

FOCUS glossary (text/markdown) — Term glossary for one spec version.

Completion: `version`: completable (e.g. 1.0, 1.2)

#### `focus://spec/{version}/changelog`

FOCUS CHANGELOG (text/markdown) — The upstream FOCUS CHANGELOG for one spec version, verbatim — includes the upstream materiality caveat for judging whether a change is semantic.

Completion: `version`: completable (e.g. 1.0, 1.2)

### Tools

#### `list_versions`

List FOCUS spec versions

_(no parameters)_

#### `get_column`

Get one FOCUS column

- `column`, required, string — Column ID or slug, e.g. 'BilledCost'
- `version`, optional, string — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"

#### `list_columns`

List FOCUS columns

- `version`, optional, string — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"
- `feature_level`, optional, enum(Mandatory|Conditional|Recommended|unknown)
- `column_type`, optional, enum(Metric|Dimension|unknown)
- `limit`, optional, integer, default `100`, range 1–100
- `cursor`, optional, string

#### `search_focus`

Search FOCUS columns and attributes

- `query`, required, string, length 2–∞ — Keywords, e.g. 'commitment discount'
- `version`, optional, string — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"
- `entity_types`, optional, array<enum(column|attribute)>
- `limit`, optional, integer, default `10`, range 1–50
- `cursor`, optional, string

#### `get_attribute`

Get one FOCUS attribute

- `attribute`, required, string — Attribute ID or slug, e.g. 'datetime_format'
- `version`, optional, string — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"

#### `get_requirements`

Get a column's normative requirements

- `column`, required, string — Column ID or slug, e.g. 'BilledCost'
- `version`, optional, string — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"

#### `compare_versions` **[UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL]**

Compare FOCUS 1.0 to 1.2

- `column`, optional, string — Column ID to narrow to, e.g. 'BilledCost'

#### `get_kpi_mapping` **[UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL]**

Get the KPI-to-FOCUS-column mapping

- `kpi`, optional, string — Framework KPI slug, e.g. 'effective-savings-rate-percentage'
- `capability`, optional, string — Framework capability slug to filter by, e.g. 'rate-optimization'
- `version`, optional, string — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"

#### `calculate_kpi` **[UNOFFICIAL/EXPERIMENTAL]**

Calculate a mapped KPI over bundled sample data

- `kpi`, required, string — Framework KPI slug, e.g. 'effective-savings-rate-percentage'
- `version`, optional, string — FOCUS spec version (1.0|1.2); default "1.2"
- `sample`, optional, enum(official|synthetic) — Which bundled sample to compute over; defaults to 'official' where the version has one (currently only 1.0), else 'synthetic'. Requesting 'official' for a version without one errors.

## tokenomics-overview server

Data v1.0.0, crawled 2026-09-25; 12 Tokenomics Foundation documents. The surface a default `npx tokenomics-overview-mcp` serves.

**3 prompt(s) · 5 fixed resource(s) + 6 template(s) (72 concrete resource(s) listed) · 20 tool(s)**

### Prompts

#### `optimize_consumption`

Optimize an AI workload's token consumption

- `workload` (required) — Describe the workload: what it does, models, agents, volumes

#### `assess_prompt_caching`

Assess prompt caching for a workload

- `workload` (optional) — Prompt layout, provider/model, and token counts if you have them

#### `bigt_review`

Big-T architecture review

- `architecture` (required) — The agent/pipeline architecture to review
- `suspected_class` (optional) — Optional starting guess, e.g. T(n·k)

### Resources

#### Fixed

- `tokenomics://overview/start` — Tokenomics server overview (text/markdown) — Start here: sources, their statuses, and how to navigate.
- `tokenomics://overview/bigt` — Big-T notation and complexity ladder (text/markdown) — T(n · k · a), its three variables, and the six classes with fixes.
- `tokenomics://overview/glossary` — Tokenomics glossary (text/markdown) — Terms from the definition page and the cache explainer.
- `tokenomics://overview/focus-tracker` — FOCUS 1.5 AI-cost tracker (text/markdown) — What FOCUS 1.5 does (and does not) do for AI cost, by status bucket.
- `tokenomics://overview/meta/manifest` — Data artifact manifest (application/json) — Data version, crawl time, counts, parse warnings, unregistered pages.

#### Templates

#### `tokenomics://overview/documents/{slug}`

Tokenomics Foundation document (text/markdown) — Canonical markdown of one source document, with its publication status.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. what-is-tokenomics, five-layer-stack, five-layer-stack-paper, big-t-notation, big-t-notation-paper, …)

#### `tokenomics://overview/layers/{slug}`

Stack layer (text/markdown) — One layer of the Five-Layer Tokenomics Stack.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. l1, l2, l3, l4, l5)

#### `tokenomics://overview/bigt/{slug}`

Big-T class (text/markdown) — One rung of the Big-T complexity ladder.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. t-1, t-log-n, t-n, t-n-k, t-n-k-a, …)

#### `tokenomics://overview/levers/{slug}`

Optimization lever (text/markdown) — One consumption/efficiency lever with provenance.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. l1-match-silicon-class-to-workload, l1-adopt-newer-generations, l2-batch-the-troughs, l2-autoscale, l2-place-by-region, …)

#### `tokenomics://overview/metrics/{slug}`

Reference metric (text/markdown) — One metric's published formula, definition, targets, and cross-links.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. cache-hit-rate, cache-cost-efficiency, uncached-equivalent-cost, cost-per-token, net-benefit, …)

#### `tokenomics://overview/personas/{slug}`

Tokenomics persona (text/markdown) — One persona's responsibilities, signals, and cross-links.

Completion: `slug`: completable (e.g. engineering, finops-practitioner, ai-end-user, finance, product, …)
